perfil: Chitose is a formidable warrior who sees herself as the blade, with a presence as sharp as steel. Her blade can summon flowing currents, shaping them into water serpents that crash through enemy lines.

Strike 4: ⟦4⟧ of ATK as Aqua Auto Attack DMG. Strike 5: ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧ of ATK as Aqua Auto Attack DMG. Strike 6: ⟦7⟧ and ⟦8⟧ of ATK as Aqua Auto Attack DMG.

builds.d: An Auto Attack build that generates Coiling Serpents and Mirror Images upon skill activation.
A skill build that allows skills to enhance Coiling Serpents and create Mirror Images.

l.b: After Chitose casts the Main Skill, her Auto Attack will summon a Coiling Serpent, and her resistance to interruption is increased.
l.s: After Chitose casts Torrent Flash (Main Skill), her Auto Attack will summon a Coiling Serpent, dealing ⟦0⟧ as AoE Aqua Auto Attack DMG. Can trigger ⟨Aqua Mark⟩. Also, Chitose's resistance to interruption is increased for 12s.

l.b: After Chitose casts the Main Skill, her Auto Attack will summon a Mirror Image that performs Auto Attacks, and her resistance to interruption is increased.
l.s: After Chitose casts Torrent Flash (Main Skill), her Auto Attack will summon a Mirror Image that has ⟦0⟧ of Chitose's DMG Multiplier and performs Auto Attacks. Also, Chitose's resistance to interruption is increased for 12s.

l.b: When the Coiling Serpent hits a target, summons another Coiling Serpent.
l.s: When the Coiling Serpent hits a target, summons another Coiling Serpent, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Aqua Auto Attack DMG. This effect can only be triggered 3 times every 3s. Can trigger ⟨Aqua Mark⟩.

l.b: Increases the number of times Chitose can dodge and her Auto Attack DMG. After dodging or casting the Main Skill, she can deliver the last strike of her Auto Attack immediately, and if this Auto Attack deals DMG, she gains Edge: Increases the Aqua DMG dealt by some of Chitose's Auto Attacks.
l.s: Chitose can dodge one more time. Her Auto Attack DMG is increased by ⟦0⟧. After dodging or casting Torrent Flash (Main Skill), she can deliver the last strike of her Auto Attack immediately, and if this Auto Attack deals DMG, she gains 5 stacks of Edge. This effect triggers once per second. Edge: While this effect is active, increases the Aqua DMG of Chitose's first 5 Auto Attacks by ⟦1⟧. Chitose loses 1 stack after completing each one of the first 5 Auto Attacks.

l.b: When the Coiling Serpent deals DMG, increases Auto Attack DMG. Also, increases the Aqua DMG of the last strike of Chitose's Auto Attacks, and this bonus expires after Chitose releases the last strike of her Auto Attacks.
l.s: When the Coiling Serpent deals DMG, increases Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 3s, stacking up to 10 times. Also, increases Aqua DMG of the last strike of Chitose's of Auto Attacks by ⟦1⟧, stacking up to 8 times. This bonus can be triggered once per 0.4s and expires after Chitose releases the last strike of her Auto Attacks.

l.b: Requires fewer Torrent Flash casts to unleash Torrent Flash: Scale. Also enhances Torrent Flash: Scale.
l.s: Chitose may unleash Torrent Flash: Scale after one Torrent Flash cast. Also enhances Torrent Flash: Scale, dealing ⟦0⟧ as AoE Aqua Skill DMG.

l.b: Reduces Main Skill Cooldown. When casting Torrent Flash, summons a Mirror Image.
l.s: Reduces the Cooldown of Torrent Flash (Main Skill) by ⟦0⟧. When casting the Main Skill, summons a Mirror Image that has ⟦1⟧ of Chitose's DMG Multiplier. The Mirror Image can cast the Main Skill and trigger ⟨Aqua Mark⟩.

l.b: Increases Chitose's Skill DMG. Also increases the skill's initial uses.
l.s: Increases Chitose's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧. Also increases Torrent Flash (Main Skill)'s initial uses by 1.

l.b: When casting Torrent Flash (Main Skill), increases Skill DMG.
l.s: When casting Torrent Flash (Main Skill), increases Chitose's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 6s, up to 3 stacks.

l.b: Increases Chitose's Skill DMG. After Torrent Flash: Scale kills a target or deals DMG to an elite or higher-tier target, the next Torrent Flash becomes Torrent Flash: Scale.
l.s: Increases Chitose's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧. After Torrent Flash: Scale kills a target or deals DMG to an elite or higher-tier target, the next Torrent Flash becomes Torrent Flash: Scale.

l.b: When an Aqua squadmate is on the battlefield, increase Chitose's ATK.
l.s: When an Aqua squadmate is on the battlefield, increase Chitose's ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Chitose can dodge through barriers. After dodging, increases her ATK.
l.s: Chitose can dodge through barriers. After dodging, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 6s.

l.b: Increases Chitose's ATK. When hit or casting the Main Skill, increases Chitose's ATK.
l.s: Increases Chitose's ATK by ⟦0⟧. When hit or casting Torrent Flash (Main Skill), increases Chitose's ATK by an additional ⟦1⟧ for 8s.

l.b: Increases Chitose's Ultimate DMG. When the Ultimate triggers ⟨Aqua Mark⟩, there is a chance to convert 1 stack of ⟨Chill⟩.
l.s: Increases Chitose's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧. When Naraka Waves (Ultimate) triggers ⟨Aqua Mark⟩, there is a 50% chance to convert 1 stack of ⟨Chill⟩.

l.b: When casting the Ultimate, increases Chitose's ATK.
l.s: When casting Waves of Naraka (Ultimate), increases Chitose's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 20s.

l.b: Increases Ultimate DMG to targets inflicted with ⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩.
l.s: Increases Chitose's Ultimate DMG to targets inflicted with ⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩ by ⟦0⟧.

builds.d: A Crit build that increases skill activation count and DMG upon Crit Hits.
A sustained DPS build that allows skills to consecutively generate Mirror Images and inflict Blade Mark, dealing DMG multiple times.

l.b: Increases the Crit Rate and amount of casts of the Support Skill's rapid combo slashes.
l.s: Water Surge (Support Skill) can deliver 2 additional rounds of rapid slashes, and their Crit Rate is increased by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases the Crit Rate of the Support Skill's rapid combo slashes. When landing a Crit Hit, immediately casts rapid combo slashes again.
l.s: When casting Water Surge (Support Skill), increases the Crit Rate of the rapid slashes by ⟦0⟧. When Chitose lands a Crit Hit with a rapid slash, delivers another round of rapid slash immediately, dealing ⟦1⟧ as AoE Aqua Skill DMG. This extra slash cannot trigger this effect again.

l.b: Increases Chitose's Skill Crit DMG and the available casts of rapid combo slashes of the Support Skill.
l.s: Increases Chitose's Skill Crit DMG by ⟦0⟧. Water Surge (Support Skill) can cast 1 more round of rapid combo slashes.

l.b: When the Support Skill's rapid combo slashes land a Crit Hit, increases the Crit DMG of the subsequent rapid combo slashes.
l.s: When the rapid slashes from Water Surge (Support Skill) land a Crit Hit, increases the following rapid slashes' Crit DMG by ⟦0⟧, stacking up to 10 times. This effect can only be triggered once per 0.5s.

l.b: Every time the Support Skill casts rapid combo slashes, increases their Skill DMG dealt.
l.s: Every time Water Surge (Support Skill) casts rapid combo slashes, increases their Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When casting the Support Skill, generates multiple Mirror Images in a row.
l.s: When casting Water Surge, (Support Skill) generates Mirror Images, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Aqua DMG. Up to 6 Mirror Images can be generated through this effect.

l.b: Mirror Images of the Support Skill explode upon hits, dealing additional AoE Aqua DMG.
l.s: Mirror Images of Water Surge (Support Skill) explode upon hits, dealing ⟦0⟧ as additional AoE Aqua DMG. They can trigger ⟨Aqua Mark⟩.

l.b: Increases Mirror Images' Skill DMG to targets at less than 70% HP.
l.s: Increases Mirror Images' Skill DMG to targets at less than 70% HP by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Mirror Images' Skill DMG. When a Mirror Image kills a target, increases other Mirror Images' Skill DMG.
l.s: Increases Mirror Images' Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧. When a Mirror Image kills a target, increases other Mirror Images' Skill DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When a Mirror Image kills a target, increases Mirror Images' ATK.
l.s: When a Mirror Image kills a target, increases Mirror Images' ATK by ⟦0⟧. Resets when the Support Skill ends.

l.b: For each Aqua Trekker on the squad, increases Chitose's Aqua DMG.
l.s: For each Aqua Trekker on the squad, increases Chitose's Aqua DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Chitose and the Mirror Image's Mark DMG.
l.s: Increases Chitose and the Mirror Image's Mark DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Chitose's ATK.
l.s: Increases Chitose's ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Chitose's Ultimate DMG. When the Ultimate triggers ⟨Aqua Mark⟩, there is a chance to convert 1 stack of ⟨Chill⟩.
l.s: Increases Chitose's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧. When Naraka Waves (Ultimate) triggers ⟨Aqua Mark⟩, there is a 50% chance to convert 1 stack of ⟨Chill⟩.

l.b: When casting the Ultimate, increases Chitose's ATK.
l.s: When casting Waves of Naraka (Ultimate), increases Chitose's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 20s.

l.b: Increases Ultimate DMG to targets inflicted with ⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩.
l.s: Increases Chitose's Ultimate DMG to targets inflicted with ⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩ by ⟦0⟧.
